subject: Preflight sandbox subsidy request — EdgeAI throughput check
content:
--- Message 1/5 ---
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@edgeai.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Request: preflight sandbox subsidy for throughput check

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model latencies look promising. We have a preflight soak planned to validate 95th / p99 tail latencies under steady-state load and to exercise caching behavior. High level: a 48-hour overnight soak starting next Thursday, targeting ~6k concurrent inference threads (~2.8M tokens total across the run).

Ask: would Redwood be able to provision a temporary sandbox subsidy (token allowance or credit voucher) to cover the run? We estimate ~120k inference minutes / ~150k token units — rough ask is for a 10k credit supplemental voucher tied to this POC.

Attached: edgeai_poc_plan.pdf (run schedule + traffic profile), edgeai_perf_matrix.csv (expected p95/p99 breakdown).

This is a time-sensitive preflight — if we can confirm by Monday EOD our CI can lock the soak window. Happy to surface more metrics if helpful.

Sofia Alvarez
CTO, EdgeAI
sofia@edgeai.ai
---

--- Message 2/5 ---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@edgeai.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: preflight sandbox subsidy for throughput check

Hi Sofia — thanks for the plan and the attachments. I’ve looped in Jonas (sales ops) to coordinate a short provisional subsidy while we validate the run.

Jonas — can you advise on a temporary credit voucher for EdgeAI? I flagged the run as preflight POC tied to deal EDG-4921. If we can approve a 7-day voucher that covers the estimated tokens, that should let them execute and give us telemetry for quantization/batching recommendations.

I’ll stand by to share any telemetry hooks the EdgeAI team needs.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

--- Message 3/5 (internal) ---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-15 11:40 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: preflight sandbox subsidy for throughput check

FYI forwarding Sofia’s email and the attached run profile. Quick context: EdgeAI is a mid-market AI startup evaluating Redwood Dedicated later this year; this soak will stress p99 tail LAT and persistence of KV cache under sustained load. They’re asking for a one-off voucher to run a 48h overnight soak.

Requested ask: 10k credits (token-equivalent). My recommended path: approve a time-limited voucher (7 days) scoped to their project ID, require a short preapproval form and HubSpot note, and ask them to share the perf logs. If we see clear infra saturation we can surface a model-routing recommendation (e.g., change quantization profile) which may become a sales opportunity.

Rachel — can finance sign off on a short-term promotional voucher for POC? Marcus — want your +1 on terms (7-day, non-recurring, attach preapproval).

Thanks,
Hannah
